properties.displayName: prod: Stripe credential failure on the restaurant API
properties.description: The prod Stripe key cannot perform an operation - a permission or configuration fault, NOT a card decline. If this fires, every card order is being rejected at capture: check the restricted key's permissions first.

allOf.query: traces | where cloud_RoleName == "restaurant-ordering-system" | where message contains "[stripe:failure]" and message contains "kind=permission_or_config"
